services.name: Acupuncture

services.name: Facial
services.desc: During this 45 minute treatment, fine stainless steel needles are inserted into the skin to create controlled microscopic punctures. The needles can go a depth of 0.25mm to 1.5mm to reach the deeper dermis layer. This creates controlled micro-injuries that trigger the skin's natural healing process, stimulating collagen and elastin production to improve skin texture and result in a smoother, firmer, healthier-looking skin. ▪︎ Softens fine lines and wrinkles ▪︎ Smoothing deep pitted acne scars ▪︎ Enhances skin firmness and elasticity ▪︎ Promotes a brighter complexion ▪︎ Stimulate hair growth ▪︎ Step 1 - Starts with a consultation with Dr. Mary to assess your skin and customize the treatment
